topic: Young hacker hunted by government - emotional backstory
title: They're Hunting Him
hook: He was just a kid when he found out... they were already watching.
description: A young hacker's emotional journey as government forces close in. A story of fear, genius, and survival.

scenes.narration: He was only sixteen when curiosity turned into obsession. A lonely kid, buried in code, searching for truth in the dark corners of the internet.
scenes.visual_prompt: young boy sitting alone at computer in dark bedroom, glowing monitor, cyberpunk atmosphere

scenes.narration: What he found wasn't supposed to exist. Classified files. Hidden networks. Secrets that made governments nervous.
scenes.visual_prompt: person typing rapidly on keyboard, computer screen showing code and data streams, hacking

scenes.narration: His first mistake was thinking he was anonymous. His second was believing nobody cared about a kid in his basement.
scenes.visual_prompt: computer screens flashing red warning symbols, digital surveillance, network monitoring, hacking attempt

scenes.narration: They came without warning. Black vans. Federal agents. A house surrounded before dawn broke.
scenes.visual_prompt: black vans pulling up to a suburban house at night, silhouettes of police or agents outside, government raid

scenes.narration: He wasn't the first they'd found. And he wouldn't be the last. But he was different. Smarter. More desperate to survive.
scenes.visual_prompt: young man looking afraid and cornered, intense eyes showing fear and determination, dramatic lighting

scenes.narration: Now he runs. Every day, another city. Every night, another fear. The government doesn't forget. They always find you in the end.
scenes.visual_prompt: person running through dark alley at night, shadows, urban streets, being chased, paranoid

scenes.narration: But here's what they didn't expect: he's smarter than they are. And he's got nothing left to lose. The hunt is on.
scenes.visual_prompt: hacker typing intensely in a dark room, laptop screens showing code, determined face, ready for battle
